author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv dual-expert (task-aware pooling + pre-norm, clip=1.0) — seed=7
abstract: Task-aware variant replication (seed=7): mean_lse_mix for non-ncRNA; mean_max_mix for ncRNA. Per-expert pre-LN + post-LN; global-norm grad-clip=1.0.
